thread:
morgan: Quick design ask — sketching a compact preview toolbar for the Embeddings inspector. Main goals: reduce vertical height, make export CTA obvious without stealing focus, and fix keyboard/focus flow for relevance table. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxx/embeds-preview-compact (mock)
ellie: Love the compact vibes. One thing — the primary CTA is currently an icon-only button on the right. Hard to scan. Can we try text + icon for the primary and a small icon-only overflow for secondary actions? :thinking_face:
devin: Keyboard/accessibility nit: current tab order jumps from row -> kebab -> global toolbar. We should ensure the row selection (checkbox) is first, then row actions, then move focus to toolbar. Otherwise screen-reader users lose context.
sasha: Copy note: "Export vectors" vs "Download CSV" — which do we prefer? For non-technical users "Download CSV" is clearer. For API-y folks "Export" maps better to other flows.
morgan: Good points. Proposal: primary CTA = "Download CSV" with a small export icon, secondary = "Export selected" in the kebab. If none selected, disable that action with tooltip explaining selection rules.
jules: Edge-case: batch export size limit. If user selects > 100k vectors we show modal: "Large export — we’ll email a link when ready." Need copy for that modal and a11y announcements (role=alertdialog).
ellie: For contrast: compact toolbar background is #F7F8FA but small text on the buttons is failing 4.5:1 at 12px. Either bump to 13/14px or increase contrast color. Also add visible focus ring for keyboard (2px, #0A66FF) — not just outline.
devin: aria suggestions: toolbar region should have role="toolbar" and aria-label="Embeddings preview actions". Export button should have aria-describedby pointing to a hidden node with export limits info.
aria-bot: a11y check: recommend tab stop order: checkbox -> title link -> relevance score -> row actions -> (end) toolbar. Also ensure table headers have scope="col" and sortable headers expose aria-sort states.
sasha: UX microflow: when user hovers a row, show small preview pill & quick rerank icon. But on keyboard focus we should show same pill — avoid hover-only affordances.
morgan: Agree re: hover vs focus parity. Also we need telemetry names. Devin, can you confirm event names for the CTA and export? I propose `preview_download_clicked` and `preview_export_selected_clicked`.
devin: Those names OK. One more: `preview_export_queued` for large exports. And send `export_item_count` in the payload.
jules: Accessibility modal copy suggestion: "Your export is large. We'll prepare the file in the background and email a download link to you. You can continue using the console." Buttons: "Start export" / "Cancel". Add keyboard trap into the dialog.
ellie: Quick layout suggestion: move global filters left, keep toolbar pinned to the right. On narrow screens collapse into a single overflow that expands into a full-width sheet to avoid cramping controls.
morgan: Figma updated with two variants: compact (desktop) and stacked (mobile). Added notes for focus order and aria labels. Please review before EOD. Also added a small CSS snippet for focus ring:
```
.button:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,102,255,0.15); border-radius: 6px; }
```

devin: quick dev note — avoid tabindex="-1" hacks on headings. Use natural DOM order where possible. I'll prototype keyboard nav and post a short demo video.
sasha: :thumbsup: Can we also change the export icon to be more distinct from the share icon? Right now they look similar at 16px.
morgan: Good call. I'll swap to the cloud-download glyph. Thanks everyone — will iterate and ping again with updated mocks and accessibility checklist.
